To: "Cecile de Jongh
Subject: presentation of Windows Tablets - two ceremonies separate from STEM Fair

 Hello Mrs. de Jongh,

 The Superintendent and our team would like to hold two ceremonies, separate from the STEM Fair, to
 have you present the Tablets to the winning public school students. We were thinking this would be
 two weeks or less from the date of the STEM Fair. One ceremony at Kean for the Kean, BCB, and
 Sprauve winners. One ceremony at CARS for CARS and Cancryn winner. Since the Tablets are for
 public school students only, this will solve any potential problems. Also, we can have great photo
 opportunities of the students and you — with the Tablets in their hands.

 Would you please support us in this approach?

 Thank you,

 Michael Harrigan
 Deputy Superintendent
 St. Thomas/St. John School District
 St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands
